summary: Escalate (Risk Gate confidence 0.51). User s.demir@aegean.edu shows 8 suspicious sign-ins from Cloudvault VPS (DE) outside baseline (F1), with most sign-ins originating from DE (F2). Sign-in path touches exposed VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 running CISA KEV-listed firmware with known exploits (F3). Chain remains unconfirmed: no observed abuse, one access signal, and vpn_session_order data quality conflict for vpn-edge-01. Recommend analyst review before containment.

risk.rationale: Verified evidence shows suspicious sign-ins from a non-baseline ASN (Cloudvault VPS, DE) with only low confirmation (0.52/0.5), plus a VPN appliance (vpn-edge-01) running firmware with multiple CISA KEV vulnerabilities (0.49 confirmed). No confirmed account-takeover chain exists, and the signals are not explained away. The data-quality conflict (vpn_session_order failing) makes VPN session evidence insufficient/conflicting. The combination of KEV exposure and insufficient/conflicting evidence requires human review rather than containment, benign closure, or passive monitoring.
